title: Do you need a deload week? 😴
caption:
A 2024 study gave lifters a week off halfway through 9 weeks: muscle growth was the same, leg strength gains were a bit lower. Deload when you are beat up or stalling, not by default. Do you deload? 👇

Muscle Building, Part 12
first_comment: "Deload week" = the week I skip the gym and call it science 😂
sources: Coleman M et al. Gaining more from doing less? The effects of a one-week deload period during supervised resistance training on muscular adaptations. PeerJ 2024;12:e16777 (39 trained people, 9 weeks)
Bell L et al. Overreaching and deloading: a Delphi consensus on a definition for deloading in resistance training. Sports Med Open 2023;9:72
Bell L et al. Deloading practices in strength and physique sports: a cross-sectional survey. Sports Med Open 2024;10:26
